name: Chou Meisaku Suiri Adventure DS: Raymond Chandler Gensaku - Saraba Itoshiki Hito yo
original_name: 超名作推理アドベンチャーDS レイモンド・チャンドラー原作 さらば愛しき女よ
source:
A visual novel adaptation of Raymond Chandler's 1940 crime novel "Farewell, My Lovely". Furyu takes artistic license with their adaptation of the novel and throws in a few twists and turns to freshen up the source material.

   As the game begins, detective Philip Marlowe encounters a bruiser named Moose Malloy at a bar. Moose is looking for his old flame named Velma Valento but in the 8 years that he's been incarcerated, Velma has vamoosed her old haunts and is living another life. Through a conspiracy of events, Marlowe finds himself entangled in Moose and Velma's drama. 

[from [url=http://www.shopncsx.com/sarabaaisikionnayo.aspx]National Console Support, Inc[/url]]
